title: bug: qa_approve and qa_reject answer nextAction moe.wait_for_task REVIEW, the in-session claim hint, but a QA seat's session is pinned to its first claim's attempt identity, so a QA CLI that follows the hint claims a second row whose get_context and verdict calls are refused ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED (QA twin of task-55a5a9f9)
description:
Held item from hunt #16 (task-151a2c54, architect-2a219562, msg-2ded7d4b). The governor filed it at 06:04Z on 2026-11-04 after re-checking it at tip 9224de15.

PROBLEM
- After a verdict, qa_approve's response sets nextAction to moe.wait_for_task for REVIEW (packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/qaApprove.ts:299), and qa_reject does the same (qaReject.ts:459).
- The QA wrapper pins the session to the claim's attempt in pre-flight (pin_attempt_identity, scripts/moe-agent.sh ~:10357, and its ps1 twin). moe-proxy then stamps MOE_ATTEMPT_ID/GENERATION onto get_context, qa_approve and qa_reject.
- So a QA CLI that obeys the hint and claims a second REVIEW row inside the same session presents the first row's attempt identity on every call for the second row. That identity is refused ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED, and the second review is wasted.
- task-55a5a9f9 (DONE) fixed the same shape for request_replan: an END_SESSION handoff and no in-session claim hint.

FIX DIRECTION
- Mirror 55a5a9f9: after a verdict, end the session (an END_SESSION sessionHandoff, or no in-session claim nextAction), so the wrapper's next pre-flight claims and pins the next row.
- Keep every other field of the verdict response unchanged.
- Sync the `### moe.qa_approve` and `### moe.qa_reject` sections of docs/MCP_SERVER.md, and any qa.md/qa.reference.md line that tells QA to keep claiming in-session.

PLACEMENT: this waits in BACKLOG on fefce964 and 77e54ebb, both in REVIEW. Both edit qaApprove.ts and qaReject.ts. Once they land, re-anchor :299 and :459 at the tip. The governor promotes the row when both are DONE.
definitionOfDone: A daemon test fails on today's code: after qa_approve, and separately after qa_reject, the response does not hint an in-session claim (no nextAction moe.wait_for_task / claim_next_task). It signals the end of the session the same way request_replan does since task-55a5a9f9. Every other response field is unchanged.

docs/MCP_SERVER.md (### moe.qa_approve and ### moe.qa_reject) and any QA role-doc line that says to keep claiming in the same session describe the new hand-off. npm run lint passes if a role doc changed.
npm test and npx tsc --noEmit pass in packages/moe-daemon.
